import http.cookiejar
import re
import urllib.request

jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
url = 'http://localhost:3210/'

def toggle():
    page = opener.open(url).read().decode()
    field = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+)"'"', page).group(1)
    boundary = 'notification-toggle-boundary'
    body = f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{field}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method='POST', headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
    response = opener.open(request)
    return response.url, opener.open(url).read().decode()

first_url, first_page = toggle()
second_url, second_page = toggle()
assert first_url == second_url == url
assert 'Notifications are <"'!-- -->on'"' in first_page
assert 'Notifications are <"'!-- -->off'"' in second_page
print('Verified off → on → off; both actions kept the current URL.')
PY"
